DATA AUTONOMY

Your money. Your data.
Your control.

We believe intelligent financial tracking should never require sacrificing personal sovereignty. You hold the keys to every single byte.

Explicit Permissions

Nothing is tracked without your direct consent. You choose whether SMS, Email, or Voice capture is activated.

Granular Access Control

Connect or disconnect your email and bank SMS feeds anytime with a single toggle. Revocable in 1 click.

Zero Ad-Tracking or Selling

Your financial information is never monetized, indexed for ad networks, or shared with third-party brokers.

Complete Data Export & Deletion

Export your clean transactions to CSV/JSON anytime. Delete your account and all associated data permanently with zero retention.

What is ExpenseX AI and how does it track expenses automatically?

ExpenseX AI is an autonomous AI expense tracker and personal finance companion. Unlike traditional manual budget apps, ExpenseX AI captures and categorizes your transactions automatically across camera receipt scans (OCR), bank SMS transaction alerts, natural language voice memos, and WhatsApp AI bot integration—delivering 100% automated personal finance.
